sessionStart.command: bash -lc 'for d in .github/instructions .github/agents .github/prompts .github/skills; do if [ ! -d "$d" ]; then echo "Missing required customization directory: $d"; exit 1; fi; done; echo "Repository customization directories are present."'

pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$dirs = @('.github/instructions','.github/agents','.github/prompts','.github/skills'); foreach ($d in $dirs) { if (-not (Test-Path $d -PathType Container)) { Write-Error "Missing required customization directory: $d"; exit 1 } }; Write-Host 'Repository customization directories are present.'"
